title: GERMANTOWN_AVE_IN_FLUX_06_02_2026

mentions.place: Germantown Avenue, from Chestnut Hill down to 2nd Street
mentions.speaker: Dante Sisofo
mentions.quote: I just got back from walking the entirety of Germantown Avenue here in Philadelphia, all the way from the northern parts of Chestnut Hill down towards the river at Second Street.
mentions.locationEvidence: START: 'northern parts of Chestnut Hill' / 'top of Chestnut Hill' (0:07, 0:25); 'I took the train to Chestnut Hill West, got off the station, and began walking down Germantown Avenue' (2:28-2:35) - start cross street not spoken. END: 2nd Street ('I wound up all the way down at Second Street', 5:10). DIRECTION: southeast, toward Center City/the river. Stats: 14.3 km, 4 hours 30 minutes, 206 images (1:30-1:34). Date: June 2, 2026 (1:52).
mentions.notes: Unclear whether he first walked up to the city line (Northwestern Ave) or started at the station (near Germantown & Evergreen); 14.3 km is closer to the full avenue. Same walk recapped in YoRaLIcCJCI - count once. Project page: flux.dantesisofo.com/projects/germantown-ave-in-flux/.
